data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antibacterials & antiseptics_

**Class:** Acridine dye antiseptic (yellow)

## Mechanism of action
- Intercalates DNA of bacteria — bacteriostatic against Gram-positive organisms

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Infected wounds, burns dressings (acriflavine emulsion/gauze), minor skin infections (largely historical)

## Dose & formulations
- 0.1% solution or emulsion on dressings

## Adverse effects
- Yellow staining, photosensitivity, contact dermatitis, delays healing

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Minimal data.

## Viva points
- Yellow acridine dye — historical wound antiseptic

_Sources: Khopkar ch.30 (Acriflavine). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
